help.toggle: How do I get a LINE ID or add-friend link?
help.linkDescription: No need to allow ID search. Attendees just tap the link to add you.
help.linkStep2: Tap the "Add friends" icon at the top right
help.linkStep4: Paste it into the field above
help.idStep1: LINE "Home" → gear icon "Settings" at the top right → "Profile" → "ID"
help.idStep2: If you haven't set one yet, you can create it here (it can't be changed later)
help.idStep3: Go to "Settings" → "Privacy" and turn on "Allow others to add me by ID" so attendees can find you
help.idOfficialAccount: For an official account, enter the ID starting with @, e.g. @abc1234
